title: Russia Economic Report 39 · frozen adapted excerpt
attribution_text: Adapted from World Bank, Russia Economic Report: Modest Growth - Focus on Informality.
content:
The World Bank's Russia Economic Report records that real GDP growth reached 2.3 percent in 2018, with part of that performance attributed to one-off energy construction effects.

The same report projected growth of 1.2 percent in 2019 and 1.8 percent in both 2020 and 2021. These national forecasts provide macroeconomic context, but they do not establish conditions in Moscow's property market or prove a causal investment outcome.
